metaTitle: Custom Heat Transfer Dress Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom heat transfer dress shirts for your team. Perfect for logos and designs. Fast turnaround from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Heat transfer decoration delivers crisp, full-color logos and designs onto dress shirts without the high setup costs of embroidery. Ideal for small to medium runs, this method works especially well on poly-blend fabrics like the Ladies' Ogio Luuma Flex Tunic, giving you vibrant branding that holds up through repeated washes. Whether you're outfitting a sales team or a company event, heat transfer offers a cost-effective way to get professional-looking custom dress shirts with quick turnaround times.
heroAltText: Custom heat transfer dress shirts with vibrant full-color logos on poly-blend fabric for corporate teams
